faqs.q: How long does a Ghana visa take?
faqs.a: It varies. Allow several weeks, and longer around Christmas and festival periods. Express options may be available.

faqs.q: Do British citizens need a Ghana visa?
faqs.a: Yes. British citizens need a visa to visit Ghana, applied for before travel.

faqs.q: Do I need a yellow fever certificate for a Ghana visa?
faqs.a: Yes. Ghana requires a valid yellow fever vaccination certificate for entry, and visa applications usually ask for it.

sections.heading: Do you need a visa for Ghana?
sections.text: British citizens need a visa to visit Ghana. Ghana applications for UK residents are made through the Ghana High Commission in London, and processing times vary, so apply well before you travel.

sections.heading: What you will usually need
sections.text:
Most Ghana visa applications need:
- Your passport, valid for at least 6 months, with blank pages
- A completed application form and passport photos
- A return flight booking
- Hotel bookings, or an invitation letter from your host in Ghana with a copy of their ID
- For business trips, a letter from your employer and an invitation from the Ghanaian company
- A yellow fever vaccination certificate

sections.heading: Yellow fever certificate
sections.text: Ghana requires all arriving travellers to show a valid yellow fever vaccination certificate. Get vaccinated at least 10 days before you travel, at a registered yellow fever centre.

sections.heading: Ghana visa help in Manchester
sections.text: We're based in Manchester city centre and help travellers and businesses across the North West and the rest of the UK. Most travel visa applications can be handled by post and email, so you don't need to visit us in person.
